title: UAV Digital Twin — Subscription Message v1.0
description: Per-tenant stream subscription contract (improvement_plan.md §4 Phase 3 & §6). Replaces unconditional full-state broadcast with tenant-scoped, field-filtered stream subscriptions.

aircraft_ids.description: List of aircraft callsigns to subscribe to (e.g. ['UAV-01', 'UAV-02'] or ['*'] for all authorized tenant aircraft).

field_groups.description: Selective field groups to stream. Omitted groups are pruned to save bandwidth and prevent leakage.

min_interval_ms.description: Minimum interval in milliseconds between updates (rate throttle).

backpressure_policy.description: Handling strategy when client socket falls behind.
